game.title: SENAI Rush
game.subtitle: Pompéia Technical Circuit
game.tagline: Six human racers. Three laps. One campus-wide sprint.
menu.title: Title
select.title: Pick your racer
char.hamster.name: Nicão
char.hamster.blurb: Stuffs a snack in each cheek and never lifts off the gas.
char.hedgehog.name: Berbas
char.hedgehog.blurb: Light and twitchy. Corners like a pinball.
char.sloth.name: TKZ
char.sloth.blurb: Slow to start, impossible to catch once rolling.
char.redpanda.name: Jão
char.redpanda.blurb: Loves a long straight and a fluffy tail in the wind.
char.bunny.name: Tsen
char.bunny.blurb: Explodes off the line and bounces back from every bump.
char.frog.name: Honda
char.frog.blurb: Steady, sturdy and very hard to shove around.
item.shield.desc: Blocks one hit and bumps rivals away.
item.taffy.desc: Drops a sticky blob behind you.
item.bee.desc: Chases the racer right ahead of you.
hint.drive.touch: The kart drives itself — drag the stick to steer
hint.drift.touch: Hold DRIFT while steering into a turn
hint.driftRelease: Keep drifting until sparks glow, then let go for a boost
hint.crate: Drive through a Tool Crate to grab an item
hint.shortcut: Tip: the marked workshop shortcut is slick — boost through it!
hint.startBoost: Tip: press gas just as the last light turns on
tutorial.title: How to race
tutorial.tip1: Drift through corners: sparks turn blue, pink, then gold. Release for a boost.
tutorial.tip2: Tap drift in mid-air off a ramp for a trick boost.
results.title: Race results
results.name: Your name
board.title: Leaderboard
board.empty: No races yet — set the first time!
board.name: Racer
settings.title: Settings
rotate.title: Rotate your device
credits.fonts: Fonts: Sora, Figtree, Noto Sans SC (SIL OFL 1.1)
results.unranked: Tuning changes are active — this run is not added to the local leaderboard.
results.local: Split-screen race — not added to the local leaderboard.
lobby.title: Join the race
lobby.help: Each player presses GAS on their own controls to join: {keys} on the keyboard, or {a} on a gamepad. Then steer left/right to pick a racer.
lobby.ready: Everyone’s in! Press ITEM ({x} / Space / Enter / O) or Start race.
tutorial.multiTip: Esc / P or Start pauses for everyone.
item.triple.desc: Three Pepper Blasts in a row.
item.star.desc: Invincible and faster; rivals bounce off you.
item.bolt.desc: Every rival shrinks and slows down.
item.bomb.desc: Lob it ahead; it blows up anyone nearby.
item.wheel.desc: A tyre that rolls straight down your lane.
tracks.title: Pick a circuit
track.campus.name: SENAI Campus
track.campus.blurb: Workshop presses, the quarry jump, campus shuttles and forklifts.
track.desert.name: Cactus Rally
track.desert.blurb: Beat the train across the tracks, dodge rockfall and leap the canyon.
track.snow.name: Frozen Peak
track.snow.blurb: Climb into giant rolling snowballs, slide on ice and jump the crevasse.
track.candy.name: Sweet Valley
track.candy.blurb: Gumballs, a sweets factory with presses, syrup slicks and soda fountains.
track.neon.name: Neon Avenue
track.neon.blurb: Night-time traffic both ways, two train crossings and a press tunnel.
track.volcano.name: Boiling Volcano
track.volcano.blurb: Jump the lava twice, duck the fire bars and lava geysers.
track.rainbow.name: Rainbow Road
track.rainbow.blurb: A rainbow floating in space: no rails on long stretches, meteors and star bumpers.
track.haunted.name: Haunted Mansion
track.haunted.blurb: Ghosts drift across, a crypt with presses, a broken bridge and ectoplasm.
track.toys.name: Toy Factory
track.toys.blurb: Conveyor belts shove you sideways, a toy train, bouncing balls and bumpers.
track.pirate.name: Pirate Bay
track.pirate.blurb: Cannons fire across the road, barrels roll at you, a sea current and a bay bridge.
track.sky.name: Cloud Garden
track.sky.blurb: A road in the sky with no rails, gusts of wind, air vents and two jumps.
track.dino.name: Jurassic Jungle
track.dino.blurb: Dinosaurs stomp across the road, boulders, mud, tar pits and a river bridge.
char.tavares.name: Tavares
char.tavares.blurb: All engine and muscle — steering is a suggestion.
char.isaac.name: Isaac
char.isaac.blurb: Not the fastest, but threads every corner like a needle.
char.lebron.name: Lebron
char.lebron.blurb: Explodes off the line and dunks on the first corner.
